args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living / Covey & Lark
args.body:
Hi June,

A quick note on a label mix-up for the PHL account:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals", so the old name is still showing up in at least one place.
- Could you check which name the contract and CRM records use, and whether the saved report needs updating?

Thanks,
Sofia
